item.title: Tariffs, Cannabis, Crash Funerals
item.ns0:title: Tariffs, Cannabis, Crash Funerals
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, we examine the potential economic fallout as a new double-digit US tariff is slapped on Bahamian exports, prompting an immediate reaction from the Davis administration. An emotional community in Cat Island bids a final farewell to victims of the tragic Shirley Street car crash, while the Health Minister reveals the next critical steps for the nation's cannabis legislation. We bring you dramatic footage of a massive blaze at an Abaco luxury property and take you on a tour of public schools as the government races against the clock to complete summer repairs. Plus, witness a night of celebration for local media and telecommunications pioneers and catch the highlights from the kickoff of the U15 girls summer soccer cup.
